name: Smart Refunds & Returns for WooCommerce
author: WpSolutions+

sections.description:
⚖️ A WooCommerce refunds, returns & RMA plugin built for the new EU right of withdrawal — and it’s free.

Smart Refunds & Returns turns order cancellations, refunds and returns into a smooth self-service flow: shoppers cancel an order or request a refund on their own — as a guest from the WooCommerce order-tracking page, or from My Account — and every request is recorded as a proper EU right-of-withdrawal declaration. A complete refund, return and RMA desk, built right into WooCommerce.

Since 19 June 2026, Directive (EU) 2023/2673 asks online stores across the EU to give shoppers a clear way to withdraw from a purchase and to send them a confirmation with the exact date and time, on a durable medium. Most refund, return and RMA plugins were never designed around that obligation. Smart Refunds & Returns was — from the very first line of code.

Every return runs as a proper declaration of withdrawal, not a vague “request”, and every submission fires an automatic, timestamped acknowledgement email — the durable-medium record the directive is looking for.

💡 This is a tool to help you comply — it is not legal advice. Always check your own country’s transposition of the directive.

That single capability is where most competitors fall short, and it’s where your store gets to stand out. 🌍 Then it gets even better for your customers 👇

👤 True guest returns — no account, no password

The feature most refund plugins quietly skip. A guest opens your standard WooCommerce order-tracking page, types the order number and billing email they already have, and can cancel the order or start a return right there — secured by a signed access token, so their email never appears in a URL or in the page source. No forced sign-up. No endless email ping-pong. Registered customers get the same cancel-order / refund-request flow from My Account.

💶 You always keep control of the money

The plugin runs the return workflow, the statuses and the customer emails — but it never touches your funds. It can’t know how you agreed to refund each customer (card, cash, bank transfer, store credit), so it never creates a WooCommerce refund or a coupon on its own. No accidental double refunds. Your cash, your call. 🔒

🧩 Native WooCommerce — nothing new to learn

Every return is a real WooCommerce order status with its own panel on the order edit screen. No separate dashboard, no new mental model. If your team knows WooCommerce, they already know this. ⚡

✨ Everything you get in the free plugin

  • ⚖️ EU-withdrawal-ready flow with a timestamped acknowledgement email on a durable medium
  • 🛑 One-click “Cancel order” button on the order-tracking page and in My Account — the customer’s entry point to a refund or return
  • 👤 Guest returns & refund requests from the order-tracking page, secured by a signed token
  • 📝 [smart_refund_form] shortcode for a clean, standalone return page
  • 🧱 Unlimited-field form builder — text, textarea, checkbox, radio and select, drag-and-drop
  • 🗂️ Five return statuses (requested, approved, completed, cancelled, refused) — plus reopening a closed return at any time, silently
  • 🖥️ Record & edit a return straight from the order screen — perfect for requests that arrive by phone or email
  • 📧 Customer status emails, with per-change control over whether one is sent
  • 📨 Multi-recipient admin emails — warehouse and finance, on the same notification
  • 🔗 Return-policy link inside the emails
  • 🚀 HPOS and block cart/checkout compatible

Nothing above is a teaser. It’s all fully functional, with no metering, no time limit and no licence to enter.

🚀 Ready to scale? Meet Pro

Free already runs a complete, compliant return and refund desk. When your volume grows and you want a full RMA workflow end-to-end, Smart Refunds & Returns Pro adds the next layer. It ships as a separate plugin, so nothing in this free version is ever locked, throttled or waiting for a key. 🙌

Pro unlocks:

  • 🔄 The full 9-status RMA workflow (awaiting customer reply, awaiting return, checking returned items, in progress…), each with its own transactional email
  • 📎 File / image upload, multi-select and HTML field types — let customers attach a photo of the defect
  • 📦 Partial returns — customers pick exactly which items and quantities to send back
  • 🚚 Refund shipping cost and extra order fees
  • 🎯 Conditional visibility — show the return button only when your rules match (days since order, product, category, payment method, user role)
  • ⏱️ Auto-hide the return button after your chosen window
  • 📄 Custom return instructions, sent automatically the moment you accept a return

👉 See it all on the Pro page. Start free today, upgrade the day you need to — your data and setup carry straight over.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New, or copy it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Smart Refunds and enable the return button.
  4. Build your return form under the Refund Form section.
  5. Optional standalone guest page: create a page containing the [smart_refund_form] shortcode and select it in the refund-form-page setting.
  6. Confirm you have a WooCommerce order-tracking page ([woocommerce_order_tracking]) — that’s where guests cancel an order or start a return.
sections.faq:
Does it help me comply with the EU right of withdrawal?

The customer-facing flow is built as a declaration of withdrawal and sends a timestamped acknowledgement on a durable medium, designed with Directive (EU) 2023/2673 in mind (applicable from 19 June 2026). It’s a tool to help you — not legal advice. Please verify your own obligations and your country’s transposition.

Can customers cancel an order or request a refund themselves?

Yes. A “Cancel order” button appears on the WooCommerce order-tracking page and in My Account, and it takes the customer straight into the refund/return flow — no back-and-forth emails needed.

Do customers need an account to start a return?

No. Guests start a return from the WooCommerce order-tracking page using their order number and billing email. Registered customers can also use My Account. Guest access is secured by a signed token, so the email is never exposed in the URL.

Does the plugin refund the money automatically?

No, and that’s deliberate. It can’t know how you agreed to refund each customer, so it never creates a WooCommerce refund or a coupon on its own. You settle the refund however you agreed, then mark the return completed.

Does it work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce custom order tables and with the block-based cart and checkout.

Where do returns show up in the admin?

Each return sets a dedicated status on the order and adds a panel to the order edit screen, where you move it through your workflow. Returns also get their own filter in the WooCommerce Orders list.

Is there a Pro version, and is the free one crippled?

There’s a Pro version, and no — the free plugin is fully functional. Pro is a separate plugin, not an unlock code, so nothing here is disabled waiting for a licence. Pro adds the full RMA workflow with an email for every step, conditional visibility, partial returns, shipping and fee refunds, and the upload / multi-select / HTML field types. See the Pro page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • The Pro-only options now appear in the settings as clearly labelled, locked previews, so you can see exactly what Pro adds before upgrading — nothing is hidden and nothing nags.

1.0.3

  • Unlimited form fields are now part of the free plugin, and the one-field limit is gone.
  • Admin emails can now go to several recipients, and you can decide per change whether the customer is emailed.
  • Answers and quantities can now be edited from the order screen in the free plugin.
  • The Pro features are no longer part of this download: they now ship as a separate plugin instead of being included and switched off.
  • Translation files are no longer bundled; translations come from translate.wordpress.org.

1.0.2

  • Reopening a closed return is now available in the free edition too, and never emails the customer.
  • The Reopen button now uses the standard WooCommerce button styling, matching the order screen.

1.0.1

  • The upgrade links now open the secure hosted checkout in a new tab for a smoother, more reliable purchase.
  • Added the upgrade prompt to the Return instructions setting.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Guest returns from the WooCommerce order tracking page, secured by a signed access token.
  • [smart_refund_form] shortcode for a standalone return page.
  • Withdrawal-friendly wording and a timestamped acknowledgement email on a durable medium.
  • Return workflow with a dedicated order status, admin panel and transactional emails.
  • The plugin never creates a WooCommerce refund or coupon on its own.
  • Compatible with HPOS and the block-based cart and checkout.
